summary: The prepared R1 pair correctly uses matched completed native packets for parallel two-card head fitting, then serial complete full98 selection and selected/trained three-benchmark rounds. No blocking source defect was found. Runtime readiness is not attested.

verification.environment_note: Initial bare PATH Python parser attempt failed with No pyvenv.cfg file. The same parser succeeded using the existing offline uv-managed CPython3.13. No packages installed or project environment changed.

limitations: SOURCE PASS is not runtime readiness or result completion; actual completed H3 packets and actual remote checkpoints/datasets were not loaded.

Original collection-driver exits, pure baseline234 completion/scoring, RGBT210 checksum/extraction/inventory, CPU execution checks, actual search-routing GPU sanity, and GPU2/3 capacity remain separate launch prerequisites.
The pair driver does not itself inspect original collectors/baseline process exit or available GPU capacity.
Receipt-validation exceptions can leave queue_state at RUNNING or COMMANDS_EXITED_SUCCESSFULLY, as already disclosed in plan.json; use process exit and required completion artifacts together.
Matched initialization, data and update budget do not promise identical final C weights because gradient clipping covers the full trainable head set.
Full completion deletes scheduled candidates after preserving best/trained_best; completed-fit reuse is not a general rerun/resume facility.
Remote official-toolkit runtime behavior and measured visual routing were not tested in this source review.
